subject: POC: Integration & evaluation handoff — implementation plan and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Lopez <nadia.lopez@altaprise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Integration & evaluation handoff — implementation plan and next steps

Hi Nadia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed execution path so we can get the POC running next week. I kept this deliberately prescriptive to reduce back-and-forth.

High-level objective
- Run a 2-week POC to validate Redwood inference for Altaprise features: real-time chat completions (streaming), bulk embeddings for search, and a small reranker flow for result prioritization.

Success criteria (draft) — we'll finalize after your confirmation:
- Latency: 95th percentile < 220ms for 256-token streaming responses on our test harness.
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s under synthetic traffic with automatic batching enabled.
- Quality: reranker MRR uplift >= 12% on your benchmark queries compared to current baseline.
- Integration: SDK-based streaming integration in your staging environment with KV cache warmed within 24 hours.

Technical plan & ownership (proposed)
- Altaprise: provide staging dataset (500 representative queries) and API endpoint access; point contact: Nadia (you).
- Redwood SE (Ben): SDK/streaming integration, helper scripts, and a short routing diagram.
- Redwood PM (me): coordinate timelines, runbook, and acceptance checklist.

Milestones & rough timeline
- Day 0 (next Mon): Kickoff, infra checklist, account provisioning (we'll provide credentials).
- Day 1–3: SDK integration (streaming client), route wiring, and basic sanity runs.
- Day 4–7: Load and latency tests; iterate on batching and quantization knobs.
- Day 8–10: Reranker evaluation and quality gating with your benchmark.
- Day 11–14: Acceptance window, instrumentation handoff, and next-step recommendations.

API/SDK specifics we suggest for your engineers
- Primary integration: Redwood JavaScript SDK for streaming (websocket fallback supported).
- Routes: "/v1/generate/stream" for chat; "/v1/embeddings/bulk" for batch embeddings; "/v1/rerank" for reranker calls.
- Tool calling: we recommend using our function-calling JSON schema for deterministic post-processing (we'll share a sample).

Attachments I attached: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (editable), sdk-route-and-streaming-diagram.png, mutual-action-plan-2026-08-28.pdf.

Questions for you (quick)
1) Is the suggested 2-week window workable given your release schedule?
2) Can your eng team provide a staging URL and dataset slice by end of day Friday?
3) Any regulatory or IP constraints we should be aware of for sample data?

If that all looks good I can schedule a 30m technical kickoff with Ben and your eng lead Tuesday morning.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Nadia Lopez <nadia.lopez@altaprise.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Altaprise Eng Team <eng@altaprise.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Integration & evaluation handoff — implementation plan and next steps

Thanks Soojin — this is great and very actionable. Quick answers:
- 2-week window is fine for us; we'd prefer kickoff Tuesday 9am PT.
- We'll share a staging URL and a 500-query sample by EOD Monday. Our eng lead (cc'd) will own the data handoff.
- No regulatory blocks for the sample but we'll scrub PII; we'll flag anything that should not leave our environment.

A couple of clarifying items from our side:
1) For the reranker evaluation, can you confirm the input/output schema you expect (so we can map our features)?
2) On streaming: we have a web app and a server-side worker that will call the streaming endpoint; any best-practice for handling partial tokens + reconnects?

Please add Ben to any technical kickoff invites. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Nadia
Nadia Lopez | Head of Product, Altaprise
nadia.lopez@altaprise.com | +1 (650) 555-2310

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Lopez <nadia.lopez@altaprise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Altaprise Eng Team <eng@altaprise.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Integration & evaluation handoff — implementation plan and next steps

Thanks, Nadia — answered inline and attached a small example payload.

1) Reranker schema (summary) — attached example JSON in the Drive link:
- Request: list of (query_id, query_text, candidate_id, candidate_text, feature_vector optional)
- Response: candidate_id + score (float) + explainability snippet (optional)

We'll provide a mapping utility in the repo so your team can convert whatever feature set you currently use into our expected payload.

2) Streaming best-practices:
- Client should be able to accept partial deltas and render incrementally; we send token diffs and a finalizer event when generation completes.
- For reconnects: we recommend the client re-open the stream with a continuation token (we'll hand you the token flow); server-side worker can buffer last committed token to avoid duplication.

Kickoff scheduling: Ben, can you take the Tuesday 9am PT slot? I'll send a calendar invite with the technical agenda and the shared Drive links.

Attached: altaprise-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (updated with reranker row), sdk-route-and-streaming-diagram.png, mutual-action-plan-2026-08-28.pdf.

Action items (owners)
- Altaprise / Nadia: staging URL + 500-query sample (owner: Nadia) — due Mon EOD.
- Redwood / Ben: SDK example repo, streaming sample client, reranker mapping utility — due Tue morning for kickoff demo.
- Redwood / Soojin: Kickoff agenda + mutual action plan in Drive + acceptance checklist — sent with invite.

I'll include a short checklist in the invite for infra items (ingress IPs, API keys, CORS rules).

Thanks —
Soojin

- If you need extended duration or dedicated capacity for consistent load tests we can add a short-term dedicated pool — Ben and I will price that separately.
